nodes.description: Public array in Factory holding the addresses of all spawned Artwork contracts.
Hardcoded Registrar contract address used by Factory to check hash uniqueness and register artworks.
Constant function returning artworks.length (number of deployed artworks).
Public function that deploys a new Artwork contract and registers it with the Registrar.
msg.sender used as the owner of the newly created Artwork without any authorization check.
External calls: Interface(registrar).isSHA256HashRegistered, registerArtwork and the new Artwork deployment.
Parameter _SHA256ofArtwork supplied by caller to newArtwork.
Parameter _ownerCommission supplied by caller to newArtwork.
Current owner of the Artwork contract; receives owner commission and can change ownership.
SHA256 hash uniquely identifying the artwork.
Maximum number of pieces; reduced by burns.
Title of the artwork.
Public link to the artwork file.
Link to the proof of authorship set by the owner.
Arbitrary custom text stored with the artwork.
Owner commission in basis points applied to every sale.
Current lowest ask price for a piece.
Address of the seller holding the current lowest ask.
Timestamp when the lowest ask was placed (24h cancel lock).
Flag indicating whether a piece is currently for sale.
Current highest bid price.
Address of the current highest bidder.
Timestamp when the highest bid was placed (24h cancel lock).
Block timestamp of contract creation used for the one year Ethart lock.
Flag indicating an active bid exists.
Flag indicating that the authorship proof has been provided.
Number of pieces awarded to Ethart when proof is set.
ERC20-style balance mapping of pieces per address.
ERC20 allowance mapping owner => spender => amount.
Hardcoded Registrar contract address used for payouts and rewards.
Ethart revenue reward in basis points, fixed at construction.
Ethart art reward in basis points, fixed at construction.
Referrer address of the artist.
Referrer reward in basis points of the Ethart revenue reward.
Constructor storing artwork metadata and pulling reward configuration from the Registrar.
Transfers contract ownership; restricted by onlyBy(owner).
Owner-only proof submission that awards Ethart pieces using timestamp-based randomness.
ERC20 transfer of pieces, blocked for the lowest ask holder via notLocked and onlyPayloadSize.
Constant ERC20 totalSupply returning editionSize.
Constant ERC20 balance lookup on piecesOwned.
ERC20 transferFrom spending allowed allowance of msg.sender.
ERC20 approve setting allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
Constant ERC20 allowance getter.
Burns caller pieces and reduces editionSize.
Burns pieces from another account spending allowance.
Payable purchase of the lowest ask piece; splits payment between owner, Ethart, referrer and seller.
Offers a piece for sale below the current lowest ask, subject to timelock.
Payable bid placement that refunds the previous highest bidder and forwards funds to the registrar.
Fills the highest bid, distributing commissions and issuing patron tokens.
Bidder-only cancellation of a bid after 24 hours.
Seller-only cancellation of a sale after 24 hours.
msg.sender used for ownership, balances, allowances, bids, asks and payouts.
block.timestamp (now) used for activation, timelocks and pseudo-random awards.
External registrar.asyncSend calls that push Ether/callbacks into the registrar contract.
Registrar(solidity transfer) of msg.value from buyPiece/placeBid to the registrar contract.
External registrar.issuePatrons call rewarding buyers with Patron tokens.
Unchecked uint256 arithmetic (commission subtraction, balance and editionSize decrements) capable of underflow.
Constructor external calls to registrar getters getEthartRevenueReward/getEthartArtReward/getReferrer/getReferrerReward.
setProof division/modulo by (10000 / ethartArtReward) and timestamp modulo randomness.
Parameter _proofLink supplied to setProof.
Local remainder = editionSize % (10000 / ethartArtReward) inside setProof.
Parameter _amount of transfer/burn.
Local _amountOwner commission computed in buyPiece/fillBid.
Local _amountEthart commission computed in buyPiece/fillBid.
Local _amountSeller remainder computed by subtraction in buyPiece/fillBid.
Local _amountReferrer referral payout computed in buyPiece/fillBid.
Parameter _price supplied to offerPieceForSale.
Local newArt/c holding the newly deployed Artwork instance in newArtwork.

edges.reason: msg.sender becomes the owner of the new Artwork with no authorization check in newArtwork.
newArtwork triggers the external registrar and Artwork-deployment calls.
The external call target is derived from the factory registrar state variable.
_SHA256ofArtwork drives the duplicate hash check in newArtwork.
_ownerCommission is forwarded into the new Artwork constructor.
Local newArt holds the deployed Artwork instance returned by newArtwork.
onlyBy(owner) compares msg.sender with the stored owner in changeOwner.
setProof is restricted to the owner through the onlyBy modifier.
notLocked(msg.sender,_amount) gates transfers executed by the lowest ask holder.
transferFrom spends the allowance granted to msg.sender.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
notLocked(msg.sender,_amount) gates burning of pieces.
burnFrom spends allowed[_from][msg.sender].
The buyer msg.sender receives the purchased piece in buyPiece.
msg.sender is recorded as the seller holding the lowest ask.
msg.sender is stored as highestBidAddress in placeBid.
notLocked(msg.sender,1) gates fillBid.
onlyBy(highestBidAddress) restricts cancelBid to the bidder.
onlyBy(lowestAskAddress) restricts cancelSale to the seller.
activationTime is set to now in the constructor.
now is used as pseudo-randomness to award an extra Ethart piece in setProof.
ethArtOnlyAfterOneYear requires now > activationTime + 31536000 in offerPieceForSale.
fillBid is gated by the ethArtOnlyAfterOneYear timestamp modifier.
cancelBid requires now > highestBidTime + 86400.
cancelSale requires now > lowestAskTime + 86400.
buyPiece performs multiple external registrar.asyncSend payouts during settlement.
buyPiece forwards msg.value to the registrar contract with registrar.transfer.
buyPiece calls the external registrar.issuePatrons reward hook.
fillBid performs external registrar.asyncSend payouts to multiple parties.
fillBid calls the external registrar.issuePatrons reward hook.
placeBid refunds the previous highest bidder via registrar.asyncSend.
cancelBid refunds the bid through registrar.asyncSend.
The constructor calls the registrar for reward configuration before state is final.
_amountSeller = msg.value - _amountOwner - _amountEthart can underflow on unchecked math.
fillBid subtracts commissions from highestBidPrice without overflow protection.
burn decrements piecesOwned and editionSize with unchecked subtraction.
burnFrom decrements balances and allowance with unchecked subtraction.
setProof divides and takes modulo by (10000 / ethartArtReward), revertable for extreme values.
A malicious registrar could re-enter buyPiece through asyncSend before state is settled.
A malicious registrar could re-enter fillBid through asyncSend payouts.
issuePatrons external hook can re-enter buyPiece.
registrar.transfer fallback could re-enter placeBid before flags are cleared.
Constructor assigns the owner address.
Constructor stores SHA256ofArtwork.
Constructor stores editionSize.
Constructor stores ownerCommission.
Constructor sets activationTime to now.
Constructor pulls ethartRevenueReward from the registrar.
Constructor pulls ethartArtReward from the registrar.
Constructor resolves the referrer from the registrar.
Constructor pulls referrerReward from the registrar.
changeOwner overwrites the owner state variable.
setProof stores _proofLink into proofLink.
setProof sets proofSet to true.
setProof computes and stores ethartArtAwarded.
setProof assigns piecesOwned to registrar and owner.
transfer updates piecesOwned balances.
transferFrom updates piecesOwned balances.
transferFrom decrements the allowed allowance.
approve sets the allowed allowance.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
burn reduces editionSize by _amount.
burnFrom reduces editionSize by _value.
burnFrom reduces the allowed allowance.
buyPiece resets lowestAskPrice to zero.
buyPiece clears lowestAskAddress after paying the seller.
buyPiece clears the pieceForSale flag.
buyPiece moves a piece from the seller to the buyer in piecesOwned.
offerPieceForSale sets lowestAskPrice.
offerPieceForSale sets lowestAskAddress.
offerPieceForSale records lowestAskTime.
offerPieceForSale sets pieceForSale to true.
placeBid records highestBidPrice.
placeBid records highestBidAddress.
placeBid records highestBidTime.
placeBid sets pieceWanted to true.
placeBid forwards the bid to the registrar contract address.
fillBid resets highestBidPrice.
fillBid clears highestBidAddress.
fillBid clears pieceWanted.
fillBid moves a piece to the highest bidder.
cancelBid zeroes highestBidPrice.
cancelBid clears highestBidAddress.
cancelBid clears pieceWanted.
cancelSale zeroes lowestAskPrice.
cancelSale clears lowestAskAddress.
cancelSale clears pieceForSale.
_proofLink is written into proofLink by setProof.
Local remainder feeds the Ethart award division/modulo math in setProof.
_amount bounds the balance update in transfer.
_amount bounds the burn amount.
_amountOwner is computed from msg.value and ownerCommission.
_amountEthart is computed from msg.value and ethartRevenueReward.
_amountSeller is derived by unchecked subtraction.
_amountReferrer is sent to the referrer via asyncSend.
_price becomes the new lowest ask price.

normalization_plan.reason: The hash parameter only exists to drive the registrar uniqueness check inside newArtwork.
The commission parameter is only forwarded to the Artwork constructor by newArtwork.
newArt is the transient handle of the Artwork instance deployed by newArtwork.
_proofLink is a transient string that becomes the proofLink state variable inside setProof.
remainder is a temporary value used only for the award arithmetic in setProof.
_amount is the transient quantity controlling the piece movement in transfer/burn.
_amountOwner is a transient payout value computed inside buyPiece.
_amountEthart is a transient Ethart commission value computed inside buyPiece.
_amountSeller is a transient remainder payout computed inside buyPiece.
_amountReferrer is a transient referral payout computed inside buyPiece.
_price is only used to populate lowestAskPrice during offerPieceForSale.
